issue_title: Saving a note twice duplicates it
issue_body:
Steps:
1. Create a note
2. Press save twice

The note shows up two times in the list.
It would be nice to have a dark theme, especially at night.
Is there a way to export all notes as plain text files?

issue_title: Crash when the city name has an accent
issue_body: Running the tool with a city like Malmo, spelled with an accent, raises an encoding error.
Please add a flag that prints temperatures in Fahrenheit.
The wind direction is shown as north when the forecast says south.

issue_title: Which API key do I need?

issue_body: Add rumble support for gamepads, at least on desktop.
When the window is resized, every sprite flickers for one frame.
A JSON export would make it easier to build external level editors.
